name: MusicFin: Smarter Music Tagging
description: Context-based album assignment for Jellyfin music libraries (Deezer, MusicBrainz, iTunes, Discogs, or Open Opus).
overview: Fixes album names, track numbers, years, and genres using artist-wide overlap matching.

versions.changelog: Prefer album coverage ratio over raw hit count; keep base albums when bonus tracks are owned as singles (Dreamland / TobyMac Collection fixes).
Singles compete with albums on coverage percent so a 1/1 single beats a 1/20 album hit.
Per-track album assignment: prefer exact studio titles over live variants; strip trailing artist from titles; case-insensitive artist grouping.
Separate plugin identity (new GUID) from the old Smarter Music Tagging install.
